rules.statement: A devisee's share in property is subject to a right of pre-emption by other shareholders, as evidenced by the will’s prohibition on selling or mortgaging shares to non-shareholders.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think that the intention of the testators was, as far as possible, to preserve the property in the family. To effectuate that intention they (1) bequeathed it to their children, the shareholders: 'to be held and possessed in common;'"
